title: How Long Can Markets Ignore the Oil Supply Shock?
executive_summary: The video discusses the potential impact of an oil supply shock on markets, given the historical energy disruption from the Iran conflict, with Morgan Stanley's Global Head of Fixed Income Research and Head of Commodity Research sharing their views.

asset_allocation_views: Caution on equities due to potential oil supply shock
risk_assessments: Upside risk to oil prices due to supply shock
Downside risk to equities due to increased volatility
profile_data.market_outlook: Morgan Stanley analysts discuss potential for markets to continue ignoring oil supply shock, but see risks to this view.
